other_conditions: Must have engaged in building or construction work for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months.
Parents must be registered members of the Jammu & Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board with active membership.
Applicant must be a student and regular in attendance.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 for regular students pursuing diploma, ITI, engineering, or professional degree courses.
